# Installation

Install the _{{package}}_ package with

```{r}
#| eval: false
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("{{package}}")
```

Once installed, load the package with

```{r}
#| message: false
library({{package}})
```

# Support, bug reports, and source code availability

Please ask for help about using this package on the
[Bioconductor support site](https://support.bioconductor.org). Remember to
tag your question with '{{package}}', so that the maintainer is notified.

Retrieve the source code for this package from its canonical location

```
git clone https://git.bioconductor.org/packages/{{package}}
```

Use the [bug report URL]({{bug_reports}}) to report bugs in _{{package}}_;
remember to reduce your bug report to a simple reproducible example.
